answer: Seasoned rewards: a new identity earns 5% of the full reward in its first week, rising 5 points a week to 100% after about 20 weeks of unbroken answers, and any missed week restarts the climb. Each identity also pays 0.5 POA a week in upkeep. A farmer running 1,000 clones burns 500 POA a week for months while collecting crumbs, so the payoff stays far past the dawn of the attack. Trust grows like a vine on a trellis, one steady week at a time, and no fresh clone can buy a shortcut.
